blocks.text: After Mendel's work was rediscovered, the role of chromosomes in heredity was suggested, and the behaviour of chromosomes during meiosis was found to explain his laws.

items: Gene linkage: genes on the same chromosome tend to be inherited together, which counters independent assortment.
Crossing over: exchange of segments between homologous chromosomes in meiosis I, which separates linked genes and modifies the progeny.
